content.introduction: On October 26, 2026, GeekWire reported that former GitHub CEO launched a rival platform built for AI coding agents. The same day, Microsoft made a new ‘voluntary exit’ offer to about a quarter of its workforce, including some executives. On October 28, 2026, former T-Mobile CEO Mike Sievert exited the board of directors, and Blue Origin leased a former Bartell Drugs warehouse south of Seattle for a new manufacturing site. On October 20, 2026, Amazon announced a record 300k holiday hires, while autonomous flight startup Reliable Robotics opened a radar hub in the Seattle area with a valuation topping $1 billion.
